manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Transfer the soft bread with golden edges and the palm-sized braided golden bread from the table to the shallow rectangular breadbasket.

Task description: Transfer the golden soft bun with a gold edge on the right and the palm-sized golden woven bun on the left from the table into the shallow rectangular bread basket at the front center.

Success criteria: Both loaves of bread have been placed in the basket, horizontally near the basket’s footprint and at or above approximately tabletop height; both grippers are open and have released the bread.

## Execution tips

- For the gold-edged soft bread, grip thick middle sections of opposite edges; for braided bread, choose full opposing side regions. Avoid sharp corners, thin ends and deep grooves to ensure ample pad contact.
- Make the gripper opening slightly wider than the grasp point. Before closing, confirm the fingers are on opposite sides of the bread and enclose it effectively, rather than touching only the top and pushing it away.
- Near the shallow basket, keep the bread bottom and fingertips high enough to clear the rim. If changing its orientation, do so above the basket where there is ample room, reducing contact with the basket wall.
- If there is already bread in the basket, place the next piece in a neighboring open space and lower it close to the support surface before release, avoiding pushing the other piece or rolling out of the shallow basket from too great a drop.
